title: Cold rebuild: Get-LowDisk
summary: Write the CIM disk report function to its tests again, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Services, CIM and the event log* you wrote `Get-LowDisk` test-first. Write it again from memory against the
same tests, **no hints, no solution**. This check and the boss prove the module.

steps.prompt: Which CIM filter returns only local fixed disks?
steps.explain: Win32_LogicalDisk DriveType 3 is a local disk; 2 is removable, 4 a network drive, 5 a CD/DVD.

steps.title: Get-LowDisk, cold
prompt: local fixed disks from CIM, `-ComputerName` passed on, disks below `-BelowPercent` (default 15) with `Drive`, `FreeGB`
From memory: no hints this time.
